findings.highlight: She ends the conversation but it seems something else is still on her mind.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは気まずそうに会話を切る
findings.governingReading: 気まずそうに describes the uncomfortable manner in which Saber cuts the conversation short.
findings.explanation: Saber's visible awkwardness becomes an unspecified hidden concern.

findings.highlight: We don't have time to be glad that Tohsaka is safe for now
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の無事を喜ぶ余裕もなければ
findings.governingReading: 余裕もなければ says the situation leaves no capacity to rejoice despite an hour of silence.
findings.explanation: Emotional latitude becomes a lack of available time.

findings.highlight: The more we think about it the more we are hit with the feeling of despair.
findings.evidenceJa: 考えれば考えるほど勝ち目がないと思い知らされる
findings.governingReading: 勝ち目がない is a tactical conclusion reached the more they think.
findings.explanation: An assessment that they have no chance of winning becomes a feeling of despair.

findings.highlight: It's probably because, this is the last.
findings.evidenceJa: おそらく、これで最後なのだ
findings.governingReading: おそらく、これで最後なのだ independently states that this is probably the last time.
findings.explanation: A probable conclusion is recast as a malformed causal clause.

findings.highlight: She has said it clearly that we will end this fight.
findings.evidenceJa: この戦いを終わらせると、彼女ははっきり口にした
findings.governingReading: 彼女ははっきり口にした says Rin herself clearly states that she will end the battle.
findings.explanation: Rin's explicit personal resolve becomes a collective declaration.

findings.highlight: our Western and Japanese mixed style dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 和洋中と節操のない夕食
findings.governingReading: 和洋中 explicitly lists Japanese, Western, and Chinese food.
findings.explanation: The Chinese component of the indiscriminate three-cuisine dinner disappears.

findings.highlight: They have been eyeing the temple as the place to manifest the Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 前から今回の降霊場所は柳洞寺だと睨んでたのよ
findings.governingReading: Rin says she had long been watching Ryudou Temple as this War's manifestation site.
findings.explanation: Rin's longstanding suspicion is assigned to an unidentified plural group.

findings.highlight: The overseer placed a familiar there to counter Caster
findings.evidenceJa: キャスター対策で監視役の使い魔を放ってた
findings.governingReading: For Caster countermeasures, Rin had released a familiar serving as a lookout; its destruction supports her inference.
findings.explanation: Rin's surveillance familiar becomes a familiar placed by an invented overseer.

findings.highlight: We'll have Saber slow him now
findings.evidenceJa: アイツの足止めをしてもらって
findings.governingReading: 足止め means hold or slow him down.
findings.explanation: Stalling Gilgamesh becomes the malformed instruction slow him now.

findings.highlight: defeating Gilgamesh does not automatically equate to stopping the Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を止める、という事はギルガメッシュを倒すという事ではないのですか
findings.governingReading: Saber asks whether stopping the Grail therefore means they must defeat Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: The relation between stopping the Grail and defeating Gilgamesh is reversed.

findings.highlight: Ryudou Temple's Bounded Field means little if there are two Masters.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターである二人なら、柳洞寺の結界も意味はない
findings.governingReading: Rin and Shirou, the two people who are Masters, are unaffected by the temple's barrier.
findings.explanation: Master status becomes a numerical two-Master threshold for bypassing the boundary.

findings.highlight: That's not what you said earlier.
findings.evidenceJa: では、何故そのような事を言うのです
findings.governingReading: Saber asks why he said she cannot stall Gilgamesh despite judging her stronger.
findings.explanation: Saber's request for Shirou's reasoning becomes a claim that he contradicted himself.

findings.highlight: if he only has the same type of Noble Phantasm as Saber
findings.evidenceJa: アイツがセイバーと同じ宝具しか持ってないのなら
findings.governingReading: The hypothetical grants Gilgamesh only a Noble Phantasm identical to Saber's, after which swordsmanship decides the fight.
findings.explanation: The same Noble Phantasm becomes merely the same type of Noble Phantasm.

findings.highlight: he is the aboslute worst match up for me.
findings.evidenceJa: 私と彼とでは相性が悪い
findings.governingReading: Saber checks whether Shirou is saying that she and Gilgamesh are poorly matched.
findings.explanation: A bad matchup is inflated into the absolute worst matchup and misspelled.

findings.highlight: Unless we find some kind of weakness, there's no way Saber can win.
findings.evidenceJa: せめて突破口ぐらいないと勝ち目がない
findings.governingReading: 突破口 is an opening or means of breaking through Gilgamesh's advantage.
findings.explanation: A needed tactical opening becomes an inherent weakness.

findings.highlight: if a Heroic Spirit doesn't possess a Noble Phantasm, it means they don't have a weapon that originated from somewhere.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の宝具を持たない英霊なら、原典になる武器さえ存在しない
findings.governingReading: If a Heroic Spirit owns no Noble Phantasm, no weapon serving as its prototype/original exists for Gilgamesh to possess.
findings.explanation: Absence of an original weapon becomes absence of any weapon with an origin.

findings.highlight: As long as Rin wishes so
findings.evidenceJa: 凛の許しがあれば
findings.governingReading: Saber can use her holy sword if Rin authorizes it.
findings.explanation: Rin's permission becomes Rin's desire.

findings.highlight: I would cast burden not only upon myself but Rin as well as it uses the majority of her magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 私だけでなく凛にも大きな負担がかかります
findings.governingReading: Using the holy sword will impose a heavy burden on Saber and Rin and consume most of Rin's magical energy.
findings.explanation: Saber's warning about the mana burden is grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: "You heard her, Tohsaka. How much more magical energy can you spare?
findings.evidenceJa: おまえの魔力量、どのくらい余裕があるんだ？
findings.governingReading: The line is a complete question to Rin.
findings.explanation: Shirou's spoken line lacks its closing quotation mark.

findings.highlight: Saber and I can only uses her Noble Phantasm twice.
findings.evidenceJa: 私とセイバーじゃ撃てて二回よ
findings.governingReading: Rin and Saber can fire it at most twice.
findings.explanation: The limit on holy-sword use is grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: she's been looking in my direction, then quickly looking away.
findings.evidenceJa: じろじろとこっちを見たりするんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou notices her openly staring at him; the awkward look away occurs later after her outburst.
findings.explanation: Rin's repeated staring acquires repeated quick looks away.

findings.highlight: then quickly look away as if something weird is on my face.
findings.evidenceJa: 気まずそうに視線を逸らす
findings.governingReading: After an inexplicable insult, Rin awkwardly averts her gaze; her embarrassment is the observable comic beat.
findings.explanation: Rin's awkwardly averted gaze becomes a supposition that Shirou has something on his face.

findings.highlight: In a few hours we'll have to face that Servant.
findings.evidenceJa: あと数時間であのサーヴァントと決着をつける
findings.governingReading: 決着をつける says the confrontation will decide and conclude matters within hours.
findings.explanation: Settling the conflict with Gilgamesh is weakened to merely facing him.
